issues.problem: The query frames are tagged codeLine 4 and 5, but the pseudocode line 4 is the whole query loop and line 5 is 'return s'; the frames showing the loop body (adding tree[j], jumping) should point at line 4, and only the final 'done' frame at line 5. This is consistent, but the frame at index 29 (the query intro) also uses codeLine 4 while it is only describing the setup, which is acceptable but slightly loose.
issues.fix: Keep codeLine 4 for all query-jump frames and codeLine 5 only for the done frame; optionally give the query-intro frame its own pseudocode line.

issues.where: script, all presets, step after frame 10
issues.problem: The script jumps from frame 10 (start of adding a[3]) directly to the final frame (33/31/15/32) with a single speech, skipping the narration for the rest of the build and the whole query. Since truncated=true this is by design, but the jump is abrupt and the final speech does not mention that the query part was skipped.
issues.fix: Add a short bridging sentence such as 'Bây giờ xem phần truy vấn tổng tiền tố' before the final frame, or mark the skipped range explicitly.

issues.problem: The options are fixed to 1, 2, 4, 8 for every i, but for i = 3, 5, 6, 7 the correct answer is 1 or 2; the option set is fine as a superset, yet the question 'Theo em, i & −i bằng bao nhiêu?' does not state which i, so a student seeing frame 1 (i = 1) and frame 6 (i = 2) gets the same question with different answers.
issues.fix: Include the current i in the question text, e.g. 'Với i = {i}, i & −i bằng bao nhiêu?'.

issues.problem: The narration says 'Cộng a[{i}] = {ai} vào nút {j}' but in the frames the value added to node j is a[i], and the narration is reused for every node on the path with the same {i} and {ai}; this is correct, but the phrase 'vào nút {j}' with {j} changing while {i} stays fixed may confuse students into thinking a[i] is added to different positions.
issues.fix: Clarify: 'Cộng a[{i}] = {ai} vào nút {j} (nút {j} phủ vị trí {i})'.

issues.problem: The claim 'i & -i đúng với số nguyên có dấu bù hai; với unsigned phải viết i & (~i + 1)' is true, but the pitfall is attached to beat 'lowbit' while the unsigned issue only matters in the update/query loops; it is still relevant to lowbit, so this is minor.
issues.fix: Optionally move or duplicate this pitfall to the build-add/query-jump beats where the loops use it.
